- watermark update: `zookeeper-server/src/main/java/org/apache/zookeeper/server/DataTree.java:1091-1108`

The top-level `switch (header.getType())` has no `default` branch.  An unknown type falls
through with `rc.err` initialized to `Code.OK`, then the non-subtransaction path advances the
watermark.

**Observed result (executed).**

```
result error: 0 (OK=0)
lastProcessedZxid after: 43
Exception in thread "main" java.lang.AssertionError:
unknown top-level txn type was silently accepted and advanced the watermark
```

**Reproduction.**

```bash
cd /home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work
CP="zookeeper-server/target/classes:zookeeper-jute/target/classes:$(find /home/nitro/.m2/repository -name '*.jar' | paste -sd: -)"
javac -cp "$CP" -d repro/unknown_txn repro/unknown_txn/UnknownTxnRepro.java
java -Dlogback.configurationFile=repro/logback-warn.xml \
  -cp "repro/unknown_txn:$CP" UnknownTxnRepro
```

Output is preserved at `repro/unknown_txn/output.txt`.

**Limits.** The repro calls the production `DataTree.processTxn` method directly; a corrupt
or unsupported on-disk transaction is the motivating input.

item.text:
The report now documents thirteen reproduced findings at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/report.md).

This continuation added **F13: an unknown top-level transaction type is silently accepted and advances `lastProcessedZxid`**. The top-level switch in [DataTree.processTxn](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/zookeeper-server/src/main/java/org/apache/zookeeper/server/DataTree.java:855) has no `default` case. A transaction type of `999` returns `rc.err == OK`, applies nothing, and advances the watermark to 43. The repro observed:

```
result error: 0 (OK=0)
lastProcessedZxid after: 43
AssertionError: unknown top-level txn type was silently accepted and advanced the watermark
```

Reproduction: [UnknownTxnRepro.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/unknown_txn/UnknownTxnRepro.java).

The twelve earlier findings remain documented, including snapshot-fallback state leakage, zero snapshot-size division, oracle revalidation non-termination, 3+ voter oracle election bypass, digest/lastZxid snapshot incompatibility, `TRUNC(0)` data retention, runtime-exception fallback failure, empty-tail zxid overstatement, single-voter reconfiguration failure, stale `ZKDatabase.clear()` counters, missing-`acceptedEpoch` startup failure, and malformed multi-op error handling. All reproduction files and outputs are under `repro/`; the captured source remains unmodified.
